title: Can I BEAT 10,000 Player Chess?
summary: 10,000 Player Chess: an .io-style massively multiplayer giant board (compared to Slither.io/Agar.io) where each player has a few pieces and captures others.
rules: Each player controls a small set of pieces in their colour; standard piece moves; real-time (inferred).
Capturing other players' pieces increases 'Captured' count.
If your king/pieces are taken you get 'Game Over! You were ...' (inferred).
win_condition: Survive and maximise captures (no fixed end; inferred).
events: Other players move in real time
evidence: Frame line: 'Captured: 3/9/17' counter, .io logos, 'Game Over! You were ...'.
